The '''Kokash sector''' was in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], close to the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]] and between the [[Haldeen sector/Legends|Haldeen sector]] and the [[Mondress sector/Legends|Mondress sector]]. Although technically lying within known space, the sector had not been fully explored even in the days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>.

==History==
As a political entity, Kokash sector was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. The [[Outbound Flight Project|''Outbound Flight'']] expedition traveled through Kokash sector on its voyage from [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], before traveling through Mondress sector and [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

Subsequently, under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kokash sector became a part of the volume of space assigned to [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

Even in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Kokash sector was not fully explored by Galactic civilization. It may have been the location of the [[Morath Nebula/Legends|Morath Nebula]] and the home of the [[Morath]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kokash sector may be another name for [[Hatawa sector/Legends|Hatawa sector]], as both are paired with [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]] in descriptions of the territory of [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]].

It should not, however, be confused with [[Kojash]], a planet in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], in Farlax sector.
